Paired Patient Lines

Source: R/figure-plots-patients.R
PlotPairedPatients.Rd

One line per patient across ordered conditions, coloured by clinical group, with a short bold bar at the median of each condition. Patients flagged in excluded are drawn dashed with open symbols and are left out of the medians, as patients not included in a test.

Usage

PlotPairedPatients(
  data,
  patient = "patient",
  group = "group",
  condition = "condition",
  value = "value",
  conditions = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  excluded = NULL,
  group_colours = NULL,
  log_y = FALSE,
  y_label = NULL,
  x_label = NULL,
  y_limits = NULL,
  y_nbins = "auto",
  box_mm = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Tidy data: one row per patient and condition.

patient, group, condition, value

Column names.

conditions

Condition order; defaults to first appearance.

labels

Tick labels for the conditions; default conditions.

excluded

Optional logical column marking patients outside the test.

group_colours

Named colours per group level.

log_y

Logarithmic y axis.

y_label, x_label

Axis titles.

y_limits

Optional y limits.

y_nbins

Maximum number of y intervals of the tick locator (see NiceBreaks()); "auto" follows the axis length.

box_mm

Size of the data area c(width, height) in millimetres, passed by RenderFigure().

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

d <- data.frame(patient = rep(c("p1", "p2", "p3"), each = 2),
                group = rep(c("A", "B", "A"), each = 2),
                condition = rep(c("x", "y"), 3), value = c(3, 5, 2, 6, 4, 4.5))
PlotPairedPatients(d, group_colours = c(A = "#009E73", B = "#0072B2"))
